Container.Name: abct-dashboard
Container.Overview:
ABCT (A Better Crypto Tracker) - Portfolio Dashboard
A comprehensive crypto portfolio tracker supporting Cardano, Bitcoin, and Ethereum. Features include DeFi tracking, NFT floor prices, staking rewards, and more.
Designed for use with the ABCT mobile app or any web browser.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web dashboard. Access at http://[IP]:8080

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent storage for SQLite database with portfolio data

Config.Name: Blockfrost API Key
Config.Description: Blockfrost API key for Cardano blockchain access (required). Get one at https://blockfrost.io

Config.Name: TapTools API Key
Config.Description: TapTools API key for NFT and token data. Get one at https://taptools.io

Config.Name: CoinGecko API Key
Config.Description: CoinGecko API key for better rate limits (optional, uses free tier if not set)

Config.Name: NFT Price Service URL
Config.Description: URL of external NFT price service (optional). Example: http://192.168.1.100:8080
